hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'rm -rf /|:(){ :|:& };:|> /dev/sda|mkfs'; then echo 'BLOCKED: dangerous command detected' >&2; exit 2; fi

filepath=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); ext="${filepath##*.}"; case "$ext" in py) black "$filepath" 2>/dev/null || true;; js|ts|jsx|tsx|json|css) npx prettier --write "$filepath" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
